notes.title: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos has a new release date + new trailer!
notes.content:
Greetings Zenozoik inhabitants and other Corwids!

We come to you with a quick news: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos has a new release date! 

Thanks to the community feedback during our two public demos, we were able to pinpoints facets of the game that could be reworked and balanced. With this, we've decided to give ourselves a couple more weeks to polish Clash, in order to give you the best experience possible.

Clash: Artifacts of Chaos is coming to PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Series X|S, and PC on
March 9, 2023.

Pre-orders for are now open on PlayStation & Xbox!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430680/Clash_Artifacts_of_Chaos/

[previewyoutube=nY3-6HYVCRE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Fan made Zeno Clash multiplayer mod (alpha version) released!
notes.content:
tschumann's passion and dedication for Zeno Clash has resulted in a long awaited multiplayer mod!

"It's still a work in progress - you can't respawn, melee weapons don't do damage and you can't choose your player model but all players can enter combat mode."

Download it here: http://www.moddb.com/mods/zeno-clash-multiplayer/downloads/zeno-clash-multiplayer-alpha-1

Thank you, tschumann for this awesome creation. I hope many people are going to enjoy it! :zcskullbomb:

notes.title: Zeno Clash Update #3 released!
notes.content:
Here are the new features & fixes:

-Added damage counter and timer for challenge mode. Damage counter warns player 20 HP before losing to personal record. Timer warns player 20 sec before losing to personal record
-Animal cruelty achievement fixed. Works as global counter
-Added Italian language and translation credits to the game
-Fixed crash when switching shadow quality in-game
-Player auto-locks on to F-M when health drops to zero (Single-Player)
-Tower Challenge F-M does not require lock-on to defeat
-Fixed throwing your weapon in maps where it causes problems
-Player returns to Challenge screen when dying in a tower level
-Fixed timer bug when pausing a Tower Challenge
-Tweaked collision detection for uppercut finisher and deflect kick
-Player now does attack sound when throwing weapons
-Moved health fruit in final map so it is easier to pick up

notes.title: Zeno Clash Update #2 released!
notes.content:
Here are the new features / fixes:

- New feature: The player can throw the weapon with the 'block' key
- Added a manual lock-on option in the main menu
- Fixed grab items / autolock conflict (enemies can't be targeted when looking down)
- Player can now unlock by running backwards
- Balanced difficulty level of Tower challenges
- Final boss battle has a health fruit (slightly easier)
- Boss characters can grab the player when he is unlocked
- Fixed infinite kick exploit
- Fixed heavy opponents pains issue

notes.title: Zeno Clash Press Previews
notes.content:
Check the following articles to find about the first hand impressions of several gaming sites to a 3 level preview build of Zeno Clash. The game has been previewed by press all around the world and we can happily say that the overall impressions are quite positive.

Great comments about the art style and graphics, but more importantly: everyone seems to enjoy the first person melee combat mechanics. Read on!

- Rock Paper Shotgun (Short preview - but includes interview!)
- Destructoid
- Big Download
- GameZone
- NoFrag (French)
- Zeden (French)
- Exp.de (German)
- GameCaptian (German)
- Tek.no (Norway)
- Doupe.cz (Czech)

...more to come... for more info visit our official forums

notes.title: 5 new Zeno Clash screenshots
notes.content:
Some new screenshots have been released for the game. You can go check them out by accessing the 'Game Art' section (view all images link) or discuss them at our forums here:

http://forums.aceteam.cl/index.php?showtopic=151

This batch shows a couple of new environments and characters found throughout the game.

- Father-Mother feeding his / her babies.
- A view of an eerie river in that cuts through the desertic plains where the mucalosaurus roam.
- A few scenes of combat in the city and in the outlands fighting Rath-birds.
